remedies.name: Aconitum Napellus

remedies.clinicalPearl: Aconite is the remedy for sudden, violent onset following exposure to cold dry wind or a fright, with intense anxiety, restlessness, and fear of death — the patient may even predict the exact time of death. There is great thirst, a dry, hot skin, and marked fear and panic disproportionate to the physical findings. It acts best very early in an acute illness.

remedies.name: Belladonna

keynotes.t: deadly nightshade belladonna acts upon every part of the nervous system, producing active congestion, furious excitement, perverted special senses, twitching, convulsions and pain
it has a marked action on the vascular system, skin and glands

face red and hot, but the feet and extremities are ice cold

remedies.sourceNote: Enriched from Boericke Materia Medica (public domain)
remedies.clinicalPearl: Belladonna is the classic remedy for sudden, violent onset with intense heat, throbbing pain, and a flushed, hot face with dilated pupils. The whole body may feel like a furnace while the extremities stay cool. Symptoms characteristically worsen from jarring, noise, light, and touch, and the patient may be delirious or drowsy with a bounding pulse during high fever.

remedies.name: Bryonia Alba

keynotes.t: wild hops acts on all serous membranes and the viscera they contain
the general character of the pain here produced is a stitching, tearing

excessive thirst, bitter taste, sensitive epigastrium, and feeling of a stone in the stomach
dropsical effusions into synovial and serous membranes
bryonia affects especially the constitution of a robust, firm fiber and dark complexion, with tendency to leanness and irritability
worse touch. cannot sit up; gets faint and sick

remedies.sourceNote: Enriched from Boericke Materia Medica (public domain)
remedies.clinicalPearl: Bryonia is indicated when the smallest motion aggravates every complaint, forcing the patient to lie perfectly still. There is marked thirst for large quantities of cold water at long intervals, a dry mouth, and irritability when disturbed. Stools are large, hard, and dry as if burnt. Stitching pains, worse from any movement and better from firm pressure, are characteristic.

remedies.name: Rhus Toxicodendron

keynotes.t: worse first motion better continued motion
restlessness cannot stay in one position
red, vesicular, itching rash after contact with poison ivy, plants, or chemicals
intense itching with swelling of the skin, better hot water, worse at night
worse on first beginning to move, better with continued gentle motion

remedies.clinicalPearl: Rhus Tox fits restless individuals whose joint and muscle pains are worse on first movement but ease with continued motion, classically described as the 'rusty hinge' remedy. Symptoms worsen from cold, damp weather and during rest, and improve with warmth and stretching. There is an intensely itchy, vesicular skin eruption and great restlessness that drives constant change of position.

remedies.name: Nux Vomica

keynotes.t: poison-nut is the greatest of polychrests, because the bulk of its symptoms correspond in similarity with those of the commonest and most frequent of diseases
nux is pre-eminently the remedy for many of the conditions incident to modern life

sour taste, and nausea in the morning, after eating

this indoor life and mental strain seeks stimulants, coffee, wine, possibly in excess
better if allowed to finish it; in evening
headache worse from 4pm to 8pm, angry and irritable, sour belching

remedies.sourceNote: Enriched from Boericke Materia Medica (public domain)
remedies.clinicalPearl: Nux Vomica fits irritable, driven, oversensitive individuals who overindulge in coffee, alcohol, spicy food, or a sedentary lifestyle. Constipation with frequent ineffectual urging and a sensation of incomplete evacuation is classic, along with chilliness and hypersensitivity to noise, light, and odors. Symptoms are typically worse in the morning and after eating, easing somewhat as the day progresses.

remedies.name: Arsenicum Album

keynotes.t: arsenious acid a profoundly acting remedy on every organ and tissue
among these the all-prevailing debility, exhaustion, and restlessness, with nightly aggravation, are most important
great exhaustion after the slightest exertion

cannot bear the sight or smell of food
drinks much, but little at a time
nausea, retching, vomiting, after eating or drinking

burning itching skin eruptions from allergic reaction to food, especially shellfish
anxious about appearance and orderliness even when sick
restless anxiety, must get up and walk around the room, worse after midnight

critical, fault-finding, and hard to please, especially about small details

dry, rough, scaly skin, worse from cold and scratching
rapid emaciation with hectic fever in chronic wasting disease

remedies.sourceNote: Enriched from Boericke Materia Medica (public domain)
remedies.clinicalPearl: Arsenicum Album suits anxious, restless, and fastidious patients who are chilly yet thirst for small sips of water frequently. Great prostration out of proportion to the complaint is characteristic, along with marked fear of death, fear of being alone, and desire for company. Symptoms are typically worse after midnight, and burning pains are relieved by warmth despite the general chilliness.

remedies.name: Pulsatilla Nigricans

keynotes.t: pratensis wind flower the weather-cock among remedies
the disposition and mental state are the chief guiding symptoms to the selection of pulsatilla
it is pre-eminently a female remedy, especially for mild, gentle, yielding disposition
the patient seeks the open air

remedies.sourceNote: Enriched from Boericke Materia Medica (public domain)
remedies.clinicalPearl: Pulsatilla suits mild, weepy, yielding patients who crave sympathy and company, with symptoms that are markedly changeable from hour to hour. There is characteristically no thirst despite a dry mouth, and a strong aversion to rich, fatty food which disagrees. Complaints are worse in a warm, stuffy room and better in open air, and menses tend to be late and scanty.

remedies.name: Chamomilla

keynotes.t: one cheek red and hot, the other pale, worse from warmth, better from being carried
ear pain worse from swallowing and from cold drafts, extremely sensitive to noise and touch
weepy, clingy, wants to be carried or held constantly

remedies.clinicalPearl: Chamomilla is the classic remedy for extreme irritability, especially in teething infants, where the child is inconsolable, wants to be carried constantly, and rejects what was just demanded. Pains feel unbearable and are described as unendurable for the degree of the complaint, and one cheek may be red and hot while the other is pale, particularly in fevers.

remedies.name: Ignatia Amara

keynotes.t: lump in throat worse from empty swallowing (saliva), better while actually eating

ailments from anger, indignation, or humiliation, with sighing and vent of feelings
headache and gastric upset from grief or emotional upset
better from lying on the affected side or on the back, better from gentle motion

remedies.clinicalPearl: Ignatia is the classic remedy for acute grief, especially from a broken relationship or bereavement, marked by paradoxical symptoms — sighing frequently, alternating laughter and tears, and a lump-in-the-throat sensation better from swallowing solid food. The patient often pulls away from being hugged despite deep emotional pain, and symptoms are notably contradictory and changeable.

remedies.name: Gelsemium Sempervirens

remedies.clinicalPearl: Gelsemium suits the anticipatory, dull, and drowsy patient overwhelmed by fear or nervous dread before an event such as an exam or public appearance, with trembling weakness, heavy drooping eyelids, and a feeling that the limbs are too heavy to move. Fevers come on with chills running up and down the spine, without thirst despite the fever.

remedies.clinicalPearl: Calcarea Carbonica suits the fair, fat, and flabby constitution — chilly, sluggish, and easily fatigued by exertion, with profuse sour-smelling sweat especially on the head during sleep. Cravings for eggs and indigestible things like chalk are characteristic, alongside slow development in children, anxiety about health, and a tendency to obesity with weak ankles.

remedies.name: Phosphorus

remedies.sourceNote: Enriched from Boericke Materia Medica (public domain)
remedies.clinicalPearl: Phosphorus fits tall, sensitive, sympathetic individuals who are highly impressionable, fear being alone in the dark or during thunderstorms, and crave cold drinks, ice cream, and salty or spicy food. Bleeding tends to be bright red and profuse. There is marked burning between the shoulder blades and a desire to be magnetized, rubbed, or comforted by others' presence.

remedies.clinicalPearl: Sulphur is the classic 'hot patient' who cannot bear heat, throws off the covers, and has burning sensations especially of the soles, palms, and top of the head. Skin complaints are itchy and worse from bathing and warmth of bed. The Sulphur constitution is often untidy, philosophical, and selfishly absorbed in their own theories, with a tendency toward redness of orifices and offensive discharges.

remedies.name: Silicea Terra

remedies.clinicalPearl: Silicea suits the timid, yielding but obstinate individual who is chilly, has offensive foot sweat, and suffers from slow-healing wounds or chronic suppuration that refuses to resolve. There is marked weakness of nails and hair, a sensitive scalp, and constipation where the stool recedes after partial expulsion. Silicea is classically used to promote expulsion of foreign matter or splinters.

remedies.name: Natrum Muriaticum

remedies.clinicalPearl: Natrum Muriaticum suits reserved, dutiful individuals who bottle up grief and cannot bear consolation, weeping alone rather than in company. Classic features include a craving for salt, intense thirst, and headaches like hammers, often worse from sun exposure. Cold sores frequently appear around the lips, and emaciation especially of the neck occurs despite normal appetite.

remedies.name: Lycopodium Clavatum

remedies.clinicalPearl: Lycopodium suits intellectually capable but physically weak individuals, often with digestive complaints worse from 4 to 8 pm, bloating soon after eating small amounts, and loud flatulence. There is a characteristic lack of self-confidence masked by outward arrogance, right-sided complaints, and a craving for sweets that aggravate. One foot may be cold while the other is warm.

remedies.name: Sepia Officinalis

remedies.clinicalPearl: Sepia fits the exhausted, indifferent woman worn down by domestic or hormonal burdens, who feels dragged down and irritable, with a marked bearing-down sensation as if the pelvic organs would fall out. There is characteristic aversion to family members despite otherwise being dutiful, better from vigorous exercise, and a sallow complexion with a yellow saddle across the nose.

remedies.name: Kali Bichromicum

remedies.clinicalPearl: Kali Bichromicum is known for thick, stringy, ropy discharges — from the nose, throat, or stomach — that can be pulled into strands. Pains are characteristically small and well-defined, as if made with a pencil point, and migrate rapidly from joint to joint. Sinus and catarrhal complaints are worse in the morning and from cold, and the patient may name the exact spot affected.

remedies.name: Hepar Sulphuris Calcareum

remedies.clinicalPearl: Hepar Sulphuris fits the extremely chilly, oversensitive, and irritable patient whose complaints, especially suppurating processes like abscesses, are exquisitely painful to touch or the slightest draft. There is a characteristic splinter-like sensation in the throat, offensive discharges, and a tendency for every small wound to fester. Warmth generally relieves, while cold air aggravates severely.

remedies.name: Mercurius Solubilis

remedies.clinicalPearl: Mercurius Solubilis suits patients with profuse, offensive perspiration that brings no relief, excessive salivation with a foul metallic taste, and marked sensitivity to both heat and cold. Glands tend to swell and suppurate, and symptoms are characteristically worse at night. There is often a coated, flabby tongue showing tooth-marks, with an unstable, hurried, and distrustful mental state.

remedies.name: Apis Mellifica

awkward, drops things, clumsy; jealous of a sibling or new baby
ovarian pain, right side, stinging, soreness worse from heat and touch

remedies.clinicalPearl: Apis Mellifica suits sudden, puffy, rosy swellings with stinging, burning pains that are markedly better from cold applications and worse from heat and touch. There is characteristic absence of thirst despite the acute presentation, and complaints come on rapidly, resembling a bee sting in character. It is a key remedy for allergic swelling, hives, and edema of the face or throat.

remedies.name: Cantharis Vesicatoria

remedies.clinicalPearl: Cantharis is indicated for intense burning pains, especially of the urinary tract, with a constant urge to urinate though only a few scalding drops are passed. Burns and scalds, even before blisters form, respond well to it. The mental state can include extreme irritability or even violent rage, and raw, excoriating sensations are characteristic wherever they occur.

remedies.name: Drosera Rotundifolia

remedies.clinicalPearl: Drosera is the classic remedy for violent, spasmodic, barking coughs that come in rapid paroxysms so severe the patient can barely catch a breath between fits, characteristically worse after midnight. There may be a sensation of a feather tickling the throat, and coughing may induce gagging or vomiting. It is especially suited to whooping cough and deep, hollow, croupy coughs.

remedies.name: Spongia Tosta

remedies.clinicalPearl: Spongia suits a dry, barking, croupy cough resembling a saw being driven through wood, typically worse before midnight and from cold air or drinks, and better from warm food or drinks. There is often a sensation of a plug in the larynx, with anxiety and constriction on waking suddenly from sleep feeling unable to breathe, needing to sit up.

remedies.name: Antimonium Tartaricum

pneumonia or bronchitis in the very young or very old with failing strength

remedies.clinicalPearl: Antimonium Tartaricum is the classic remedy for loud, rattling chest congestion in which mucus can be heard but is difficult to expectorate, especially in the very young, elderly, or debilitated. The patient is drowsy, weak, and wants to be left alone, with a pale, sunken face covered in cold sweat during severe episodes. Nausea and vomiting often accompany respiratory distress.

remedies.name: Veratrum Album

remedies.clinicalPearl: Veratrum Album is indicated for collapse with profuse cold sweat, especially on the forehead, accompanied by severe vomiting and purging that leave the patient prostrate and craving cold water or ice, even though it may be vomited back up. Cramping in the calves is common, and the patient becomes icy cold with a weak, thready pulse.

remedies.name: China Officinalis

sleeplessness from over-fatigue, mind too active despite exhaustion

remedies.clinicalPearl: China Officinalis suits debility and exhaustion following significant loss of fluids — from hemorrhage, diarrhea, or prolonged nursing — with marked weakness, periodicity of complaints, and bloating that is worse after eating even small amounts. Symptoms often recur at the same hour each day, and there is a general intolerance to loss of any bodily fluid.

remedies.name: Argentum Nitricum

remedies.clinicalPearl: Argentum Nitricum fits anxious, impulsive, hurried individuals with anticipatory anxiety before events, accompanied by diarrhea or trembling, and a craving for sweets that disagree and cause bloating. Vertigo on looking down from a height is characteristic, along with a tendency to irrational fears and a sense that time is passing too quickly.

remedies.name: Staphysagria

keynotes.t: suppresses anger and swallows insults, then develops physical complaints afterward

toothache in decayed teeth, worse touching them with the tongue

remedies.clinicalPearl: Staphysagria suits the sensitive individual who suppresses anger or indignation from insult, humiliation, or violation, later manifesting as physical complaints from that suppressed emotion. Styes, especially recurring on the same eyelid, and complaints following surgery are classically covered. There is characteristic sensitivity to any perceived slight, with an inward simmering resentment.

remedies.name: Carbo Vegetabilis

remedies.clinicalPearl: Carbo Vegetabilis is known as the 'corpse reviver,' indicated for states of collapse with cold, blue extremities yet a craving for air and to be fanned vigorously, even in cold weather. Bloating and flatulence after eating is marked, along with a sluggish circulation and burning sensations internally despite the outward coldness.
